scope_contract: In --changed-files mode this inspector emits findings for the listed files only and tags each finding with explicit introduced_in_diff:bool. Absent/null/untagged findings MUST be treated by close.md as pre-existing/advisory/non-blocking per AC-2.6 (b) default-safe ignore rule.

scope_decision.rationale: All 15 changed files are .ts/.tsx source code (markdown rendering components, parser tests) or i18n translation modules (_default.ts + 10 locale .ts files). Prompt-inspector's detection scope is .claude/commands/*.md, .claude/agents/*.md, and other prompt/agent/command/skill markdown documentation. Cycle 9 contains zero changes to such files, so verbose-section pattern detection (## Philosophy / ## Overview / ## Quality Standards / etc.) is not applicable.

verdict.close_block_rationale: No prompt/documentation files in the diff. Inspector emits zero findings; per default-safe rule, close.md treats this as non-blocking.
